title: Social listening report – two smartphone brands (30 days)
text: A marketing team extracted the following metrics from Brand24 reports for two competing brands over the same 30-day period. Sentiment ratio = positive mentions / negative mentions.

title: Running-shoe launch – social listening before and after a viral video
text: A running-shoe brand launched its new model X-Run on 1 March. On 15 March, a viral video showed the sole of an X-Run coming off after a few runs. The social media team extracted the following Brand24 metrics for the two weeks before and after the video. Sentiment ratio = positive mentions / negative mentions.

Four posts from the period: P1 "Ran 10k in my new X-Run this morning – fantastic cushioning!" · P2 "Sole came off after three runs. Terrible quality, I hate wasting money." · P3 "The X-Run is available in five colours from 1 March." · P4 "Disgusting customer service, still no reply to my complaint."
